brief.headline: Move to 30-day terms to free up ₹8.73 L of our cash, and match the ₹66.48/KG we already pay Sayaji

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹66.48/KG for Dextrose Anhydrous IP
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Sayaji Industries ₹66.48/KG for the same material. The market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP runs ₹60–81/kg (typical ₹66–73/kg), so our target sits in the normal range. Closing this gap saves us ₹12.95 L per year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Stop paying 100% in advance; move to standard 30-day credit after delivery
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹8.73 L of our cash that is currently locked up front

brief.financialLeverage: Sukhjit Corn Products does not publish financials, so we cannot see their profit, debt or cash position. That means we build our case purely on what we know: we spend ₹1.06 Cr a year with them and we pay the worst possible terms—100% up front. We have a proven alternate (Sayaji) at a better price and six more dextrose makers standing by, so we hold real supply options. Lead with fairness (match the price we already pay elsewhere, move to normal terms), and if they push back hard, pivot to qualifying one of the backup sources.

evidence.point: We pay 100% in advance right now
Moving to 30-day terms frees up cash for us
We pay them more than our cheapest dextrose supplier
Closing the price gap saves us annually
Market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP

alternates.name: Sayaji Industries Limited (already our supplier)
alternates.why: We buy the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP from them today at ₹66.48/KG — proven quality and supply

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller; makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; a lead to qualify (verify IP monograph CoA before switching)

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji; a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ)

risks: No public financials means we cannot judge whether they are fragile or flush with cash — approach the conversation carefully and watch for any sign they might exit the relationship rather than budge.
We pay them 100% up front, which gives us zero payment leverage during a dispute or quality issue — fixing terms is as much about control as cash.
If they refuse both asks, we must be ready to fast-track an RFQ to Tirupati, Gulshan or Sanstar — have the technical specs and CoA requirements lined up now.
The market asking price band is wide (₹60–81/kg), so they may claim their price is 'in range' — counter by pointing to the ₹66.48/KG we already pay and the ₹66–73/kg typical band.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to bring you in line with the terms and price we have with our other dextrose suppliers—30-day credit and ₹66.48 per kilo—so we can keep the business with you and grow the volume.
